name: V-Up
steps: Lie on your back with arms stretched overhead and legs straight.
Breathe out and lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your shins or feet at the top.
Lower arms and legs slowly back to the start.
cues: Breathe out as you fold up

common_mistakes.mistake: Throwing the arms to get up
common_mistakes.fix: Lift with the stomach; bend knees to make it easier

common_mistakes.mistake: Lower back arching at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the feet just above the floor or bend the knees
